info.description: Bounded simulator subset of the official NetApp API (v1) discovery document. Every other official method returns HTTP 501 UNIMPLEMENTED. Storage pools, volumes, snapshots, backup vaults and backup policies are configuration metadata: no ONTAP system, NFS, SMB or block endpoint, capacity accounting or data exists, and every resource reports READY immediately. A volume must name an existing storage pool, and a pool cannot be deleted while a volume names it; derived volume fields such as serviceLevel and network are not populated. Active Directory, KMS, restore, backup, replication, cache, block device and cross-region vault settings are refused; delete a volume with snapshots only with force=true. Long-running operations complete synchronously.
info.title: Google Cloud NetApp Volumes (simulator catalog)
